name: technical-knockout
description: Agent-native technical research system for analyzing a maintainer-curated set of open-source architecture evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Research a curated technology evidence set.
interface.longDescription: Technical Knockout makes Codex use maintainer-curated reports, comparisons, dependency evidence, and source-cache context for technical research, architecture, selection, and build-vs-buy decisions. Inclusion in TK is the project-selection signal; Codex analyzes this bounded candidate set instead of discovering replacement projects on the web.
interface.defaultPrompt: Research this technical decision using the curated TK project set, and report clearly if TK has no relevant coverage.
